title: Software Engineer
description: Join our engineering team to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs. You will collaborate closely with product and design teams to ship high-quality software.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
2+ years of experience in software development
Proficiency in Java, Python, or Node.js
Familiarity with RESTful API design and microservices
Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyse large datasets to uncover business insights, build dashboards, and support data-driven decision-making across business units.
requirements: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or related field
Proficiency in SQL and Excel
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools
Strong analytical and communication skills
Knowledge of Python or R is an advantage

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design intuitive and visually engaging user interfaces for our mobile and web platforms. Work with product managers and engineers to translate user needs into exceptional experiences.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field
2+ years of experience in UI/UX design
Proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD
Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process
Understanding of accessibility standards

title: Project Manager
description: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver IT projects on time, within scope and budget. You will manage stakeholder expectations and drive continuous improvement across project delivery processes.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, Business, or Engineering
PMP or PRINCE2 certification preferred
5+ years of project management experience
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience with Agile and Waterfall methodologies

title: Marketing Executive
description: Plan and execute marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels. You will manage social media presence, analyse campaign performance, and collaborate with creative teams.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
1–2 years of marketing experience
Familiarity with Google Analytics, Meta Ads, and email marketing tools
Strong written communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia
Creative thinking with attention to detail

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive and performant web interfaces using React.js. Work alongside backend engineers and designers to deliver seamless payment and merchant experiences.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Experience with React.js or Vue.js
Understanding of REST API integration
Familiarity with version control using Git

title: Human Resource Executive
description: Support end-to-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, payroll processing, and employee relations. You will be instrumental in maintaining a positive workplace culture.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration
1+ year of HR experience
Familiarity with Malaysian labour law and employment act
Proficiency in HR software such as SAP SuccessFactors
Strong interpersonal and organisational skills

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor, detect, and respond to cybersecurity incidents. Conduct vulnerability assessments, support penetration testing activities, and help develop security policies and procedures.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, IT, or related field
CompTIA Security+, CEH, or equivalent certification preferred
Knowledge of SIEM tools, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and network security fundamentals
Ability to obtain security clearance

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create compelling visual content for broadcast, digital, and print media. Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to produce on-brand materials for campaigns and promotions.
requirements: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or Visual Communication
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
Strong visual sense and portfolio of past work
Ability to meet tight deadlines
Motion graphics experience is a plus

title: Customer Support Specialist
description: Provide timely and empathetic support to buyers and sellers via live chat, email, and phone. Resolve order disputes, handle escalations, and maintain high customer satisfaction scores.
requirements: SPM or Diploma qualification
Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Bahasa Malaysia
Patient and solutions-oriented attitude
Basic computer literacy
Prior customer service experience is preferred

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure on AWS or Azure, and ensure high availability and scalability of government digital services.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or IT
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration
Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strong scripting skills in Bash or Python
AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or equivalent is an advantage

title: Accountant
description: Prepare and review financial statements, perform audits, ensure compliance with Malaysian Financial Reporting Standards (MFRS), and support clients with tax advisory services.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
ACCA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification (or pursuing)
Knowledge of MFRS and Companies Act 2016
Strong numerical accuracy and analytical skills
Ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously
